## Recommendations of readings

-   Angel, A.; Plaut, P. (2024). [Tempo-spatial analysis of pedestrian movement in the built environment based on crowdsourced big data](10.1016/j.cities.2024.104917). *Cities*, 149, 104917.

-   Batty, M. (2013).[Big data, smart cities and city planning](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1177/2043820613513390), _Dialogues in Human Geography_, 3(3), 274-279.

-   Lovelace, R.; Nowosad, J.; Muenchow, J. (2018). [Geocomputation with R](https://r.geocompx.org/).The R Series. Chapman & Hall.

-   Valença, G.; Moura, F.; Sá, A. [Where is it complex to reallocate road space?](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1177/23998083231217770). *Environment and Planning B: Urban Analytics and City Science*, 51(6), 1290-1307.

## Examples of open (big) data sources with pedestrian & cyclists counts

-   [Toulouse, France](https://data.toulouse-metropole.fr/explore/dataset/comptages-pietons-2006-2019/information/)

-   [Sydney, Australia](https://data.cityofsydney.nsw.gov.au/datasets/cityofsydney::automatic-hourly-pedestrian-count)

-   [Melbourne, Australia](https://www.pedestrian.melbourne.vic.gov.au/#date=12-12-2024&time=18)

-   [Somerville, United States](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/bicycle-pedestrian-counts)

-   [Zurich , Prague](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/marcelbigger/automated-pedestrian-and-bicycle-count-zurich)

-   [Dublin, Ireland](https://data.smartdublin.ie/dataset/pedestrian-and-cycle-counter-api-for-dublin-region)
